message:
docs(viewer): F-22 -- S12 recovery-test assertion races the async encoder (harness, out of scope, unfixed); history #411

Records the release-sweep S12 failure as a ledger item: viewer_udp_recovery_test.cpp:1294 asserts
corrupted_keys()==1 right after SendFrame(true), but an asynchronous encoder call may not emit the
forced IDR in that call, so the zeroing happens in the later pump. Not a product regression
(1005ebe only changed the pending rule; S12 has no held frame). Left unfixed pending Codex's scope
decision, as the verifying Claude asked. No product source changes; the 0.2.103 installer stays.
